subject: Quick 15-min tech screen before full demo — Cartistry trial
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cartistry.com>
To: support@redwood.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick tech sanity check before demo (trial account)

Hi —

We just spun up a trial with Redwood (trial account: cartistry-prod) and are seeing an unexpected spike in latency when sending larger payloads (~3k tokens). Before we book a full demo I wanted to see if someone could do a quick 15-min technical sanity check to confirm the deployment shape and any obvious misconfigurations.

High-level:
- Using hosted API, model: redwood-13b-8k
- Average token latency ~420ms but spikes to ~1.1s for longer prompts
- We tried turning off prefix caching and reduced batch windows with no change

I'm on PST afternoons. Any chance to grab 15 minutes next week? Happy to share a couple of logs/screenshots.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Platform, Cartistry
liam@cartistry.com

[attachment: session.log (txt)]

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick tech sanity check before demo (trial account)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the details and for flagging the logs (got the session.log). A 15-minute sanity check sounds perfect — we can usually triage whether this is configuration, model warm-up behavior, or something environmental.

Quick ask before the call: can you confirm the request pattern (sync vs streaming) and whether you’ve enabled autoregressive sampling or are using deterministic settings? Also, roughly how many concurrent requests during the spike?

Available slots (PST):
- Mon 7/15 1:30–1:45pm
- Tue 7/16 4:00–4:15pm
- Wed 7/17 10:00–10:15am

If none of those work you can pick directly on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-schedules/15min — select “Technical sanity check”. I’ll CC Ben (solutions engineering) on the call in case we need to run a quick end-to-end check on your account.

If convenient, you can also drop a screenshot of the request payload (or the network trace) — small images are fine.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
SDR, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference
